authority.rule_source: the E39 / E39b rule R1-R3 (docs/readiness/2026-09-23-e21-native-window-four-row-e39b-v1/analysis-recipe-v1.json), with R3 read on the Perception node first

claim_boundary: Structural receipts on four historically exposed discovery windows of one call. No score, effectiveness, comparison or generalization claim of any kind.

inputs.sealed_manifest: the single attempt's COMPLETED manifest for SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-SYSTEM-FOUR-ROW-E41-V1
inputs.comparators: the sealed E39b dry run SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-SYSTEM-FOUR-ROW-E39B-V1 (flight commit 48c4bd1e; Perception 504 / 523 / 640 / 640 tokens, 2 truncated) and the E35 four-row direct arm SAEA-E21-NATIVE-WINDOW-DIRECT-FOUR-ROW-V1, read structurally, never re-scored

decision_rule.kind: receipts-only; no estimator, no interval, no margin, no bar

assertions.statement: ZERO retained rows carry a terminal_disposition whose role_id is 'perception' or 'reviewer' together with an abstention (unchanged from E39 / E39b).
4 of 4 windows deliver NON-EMPTY text: one saea-deliver-earnings-text-v1 receipt per window, zero blank deliveries (unchanged from E39 / E39b).

The Perception truncation RATE -- Perception contacts with finish_reason 'length' at the 640 cap, over Perception contacts -- is REPORTED with its exact count on every verdict, TARGET ZERO; the Reviewer truncation count at its 640 cap is reported beside it (E39 / E39b's R3 counted both).
assertions.verdict_effect: item E41's own deliverable is R3 = 0 / 4 Perception truncations; a non-zero count FAILS E41 with the named cause and the truncated note's structure (lines, words per line, repetition share) reported; a non-zero Reviewer count is a named cause carried into the next registration

decision_rule.pass: PASS iff R1 and R2 hold and zero Perception or Reviewer contacts are length-truncated.
decision_rule.consequence: On PASS root may mint the sub10 decision receipt (e21-native-window-e41-sub10-admission-v1) and flip the sub10 re-read. On FAIL the sub10 cell stays HELD, the named cause is registered, and at most ONE recovery re-registration of this dry run is allowed (a second failure stops E41 and the fix is proven on a fresh four-row dry run).

tables_required: per-role contact counts beside the sealed E39b dry run's (25 contacts)
per-role finish_reason counts (stop / length / other) beside E39b's
terminal_disposition table: role_id x reason x count, this arm and E39b
delivery table: window, delivered non-empty (yes / no), normaliser receipt present (yes / no)
contact and repeated-speech-second totals against the registered ceilings 44 / 3,960
diagnostics_required: the realized Perception completion-token distribution against the 640 cap and against the E41 bound (the digit-dense worst case 574 tokens), counts and quantiles only

Perception note compliance with the bound, counted on the sealed responses with the SAME feature code as scripts/analysis/e21_e41_perception_note_trace_read.py (non-empty lines <= 5, words per line <= 20, 6-gram repetition share, window-transcript 4-gram re-emission against the E35 four-row direct arm): counts only, never text
the Solver completion tokens per window beside E39b's (the answering node must stay near the direct arm's count)
the number of REVISE / ACCEPT Planner routes and byte-identical second Solver drafts, beside E39b's
every abort, refusal and recovery re-registration, with its cause

scorer.why: n = 4 carries no quality information; the deliverable is the truncation mode, not a number.
